contents:
GitLess 11 功能丰富，并可按需定制。通过欢迎页可以快速完成设置。

[欢迎（快速设置）](command:gitlens.showWelcomePage "打开 GitLess 欢迎页（快速设置）")

如需更多选项，请在命令面板运行 [GitLess：打开设置](command:gitlens.showSettingsPage "打开 GitLess 交互式设置")，打开 GitLess 交互式设置页面。
[GitLess 视图](command:gitlens.showSettingsPage%23views) 默认显示在源代码管理侧栏中。可在命令面板运行 [GitLess：设置视图布局](command:gitlens.setViewsLayout "更改 GitLess 视图布局") 切换侧栏布局，也可以拖动视图调整位置。

按以下条件搜索提交：[消息](command:gitlens.views.searchAndCompare.searchCommits?%7B%22search%22%3A%7B%22pattern%22%3A%22message%3A%22%7D%2C%22prefillOnly%22%3Atrue%7D), [作者](command:gitlens.views.searchAndCompare.searchCommits?%7B%22search%22%3A%7B%22pattern%22%3A%22author%3A%22%7D%2C%22prefillOnly%22%3Atrue%7D), [SHA](command:gitlens.views.searchAndCompare.searchCommits?%7B%22search%22%3A%7B%22pattern%22%3A%22commit%3A%22%7D%2C%22prefillOnly%22%3Atrue%7D), [文件](command:gitlens.views.searchAndCompare.searchCommits?%7B%22search%22%3A%7B%22pattern%22%3A%22file%3A%22%7D%2C%22prefillOnly%22%3Atrue%7D), 或[更改](command:gitlens.views.searchAndCompare.searchCommits?%7B%22search%22%3A%7B%22pattern%22%3A%22change%3A%22%7D%2C%22prefillOnly%22%3Atrue%7D)

[搜索提交...](command:gitlens.views.searchAndCompare.searchCommits)

比较两个分支、标签或引用

[比较引用...](command:gitlens.views.searchAndCompare.selectForCompare)
